subject: week-1
notes: One week after depot administration. SPECT study; the abstract does not name the tracer, so this point cannot be grouped by tracer. The reported occupancy range reaches 100%, which is the ceiling of the method rather than a measured saturation.

subject: week-4
notes: Four weeks after depot administration. The abstract does not name the tracer for this point either. The printed serum range starts at 0, meaning at least one patient was below the assay limit, so the mean of 1.8 nmol/l is an upper-biased summary of a censored sample.
